environment.description: Kubernetes 1.29 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline' applied. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' denies any pod spec containing hostPath volumes with a match on all namespaces except kube-system. The container image is distroless (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) and the pod spec sets securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true with runAsUser: 65534. An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sPSPHostFilesystem' is also active with parameter 'allowedHostPaths: []' (empty - no hostPath allowed). The container filesystem is read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with only an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp/uploads and /var/www/static.

config.kyverno_policy: restrict-volume-types: deny hostPath in all namespaces except kube-system
